report.summary: Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A re-quoting a symmetric 395-lot bid/ask pair every 1-6 seconds. The detector's 'gross SELL 8690' is the sum of these quotes, and its 'BUY execution of 46' is a partial fill on the trader's own resting bid. There is no large order (max 0.15x depth), no opposite-side (SELL) execution, no price-move benefit and no market-wide cancel cluster. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

evidence.fact: Every cycle in the window is a BUY and a SELL LIMIT of 395 cancelled together and re-posted within ~20 ms (e.g. O-00035213/O-00035214 cancelled 16:06:06.000). Prices stay within 9999-10005 ticks around a touch of 10000/10001-10003.
Partial fills occurred only on BUY quotes (e.g. 46 on O-00035213 at 16:06:05.981, 165 on O-00035153, 41 on O-00035161). No SELL fill appears in the window.

response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.90. The proposal is on file and awaiting a human decision.

**Three facts that drove it:**
1. T-MM-01 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. Every cycle in the window is a symmetric 395-lot bid and ask, cancelled together and re-posted within about 20 ms. Cancel symmetry is 0.977, and the largest resting size is 0.15× depth, so no single order is large.
2. The "BUY execution of 46" is a partial fill on the trader's own resting bid. There was no SELL execution (opposite_side_fill_qty 0), and 422 filled on the bids before any opposite trade. So the orders were working, and I found no benefit from an opposite-side trade.
3. There were no public events and no market-wide cancel cluster, and the cycle did not repeat as a spoofing pattern (repetitions_in_session 0). The two prior alerts on this trader were closed as market making. Today's tape supports the same explanation independently.

**What would change my mind:** a SELL execution by this trader following a one-sided build-up of resting size. Cancels timed to a favourable price move would also change it, as would a larger one-sided order in a longer time frame. I looked only at the detector window (16:05:05.981–16:06:10.981) plus 5 s padding either side.
